modern: In the mind of one who is disciplined and purified you will find no corrupt matter, nor impurity, nor any sore skinned over. Nor is his life incomplete when fate overtakes him, as one might say of an actor who leaves the stage before the play is ended and finished. Besides, there is nothing in him servile, nor affected, nor too closely bound to other things, nor yet detached from them, nothing deserving blame, nothing which seeks a hiding place.
original: In the mind of one who is chastened and purified thou wilt find no corrupt matter, nor impurity, nor any sore skinned over. Nor is his life incomplete when fate overtakes him, as one may say of an actor who leaves the stage before ending and finishing the play. Besides, there is in him nothing servile, nor affected, nor too closely bound [to other things], nor yet detached [from other things], nothing worthy of blame, nothing which seeks a hiding-place.
